title: Scheduled Session Garbage Collection in Laravel 13.39
content:
Laravel 13.39 adds a session:garbage-collect command for scheduled session cleanup, keyless models with #[Table(key: false)], and durations on JobAttempted.

The post Scheduled Session Garbage Collection in Laravel 13.39 appeared first on Laravel News.
